svg.aria-label: TransportLab entropic transport plans and convergence audit

g.text: TransportLab | cost, entropy and feasibility are different
Six uniform source/target points. Heatmaps show every plan cell numerically, shared scale0 to1/6.
Unregularized uniform assignment: 0.450000, all720 permutations. Independence cost: 4.227778.
epsilon0.1 reached the 5,000-iteration cap. Its slightly infeasible cost is not an optimality certificate.
Objective = cost - epsilon*entropy. Different epsilons have different objectives; do not rank those scalars.
Self-transport cost at epsilon2: 1.249807, not zero. This is not a debiased Sinkhorn divergence.
Squared Euclidean ground cost is not a metric. No learned correspondence, downstream task or wall-clock speed claim.
Full plans, marginal history and barycentric target means in JSON. Means are not target-distributed samples.
